Package com.openvireo.core.java

Class JServiceAccount

java.lang.Object
com.openvireo.core.java.JServiceAccount
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable
public final class JServiceAccount extends Object implements AutoCloseable
The Java facade of ServiceAccount: every suspend method returns a
invalid reference 
CompletableFuture
that runs on scope (cancelling the future cancels the call), objects come back as J wrappers on the same scope, and unsigned numbers are the next wider signed type. unwrap gives the generated object; close frees it.
